schema.description: Polymorphic historical or predicted datapoint query. Select `all` to return every value, `interval` to aggregate values into time buckets, `lttb` to downsample a numeric or boolean series, or `nearest` to retrieve the last numeric value at or before a time. Returned datapoints use x for the timestamp and y for the value. When a query retains an unavailable datapoint, its JSON representation contains x but omits y.

all.description: Returns every stored datapoint in the inclusive range, ordered from newest to oldest. Use this when the complete series is needed without aggregation or downsampling. Supports numeric, boolean, text, and JSON-compatible complex attribute values. Unavailable values retain their stored timestamps and are returned as null. Boolean values are returned as 1 for true, 0 for false, and null for unavailable values.
all.title: AssetDatapointAllQuery

formula.description: Aggregation applied per bucket: `MIN`, `AVG`, and `MAX` calculate the corresponding value; `DIFFERENCE` calculates the change between the last values of consecutive buckets; `COUNT` counts stored datapoints, including null-valued rows; `SUM` totals numeric values (or true values for booleans); `MODE` selects the most frequent value; and `MEDIAN` selects the middle value. `DIFFERENCE` is numeric only. For numeric and boolean attributes, MIN, AVG, MAX, SUM, MODE and MEDIAN ignore null values and return null for buckets with no available values. Empty gap-filled buckets return null for COUNT. MODE ties select the smaller numeric value or true for booleans. Boolean MEDIAN returns 1 when the median of available 1/0 values is at least 0.5, otherwise 0; it returns null when unavailable. DIFFERENCE uses the last stored value per bucket. With gap filling enabled, empty buckets carry the previous bucket value, while explicit null values interrupt carry-forward. A difference is null if either endpoint is unavailable. The first returned bucket has a difference of zero if its value is available; observations outside the query range are not used.

gapFill.description: When true, returns empty buckets across the requested range using time-bucket gap filling; their aggregate is generally null. When false, only buckets containing datapoints are returned. MODE currently returns only buckets containing datapoints regardless of this flag. Defaults to false.

interval.description: PostgreSQL interval literal that sets the bucket width. Include a positive amount and unit, for example `1 hour`, `5 minutes`, or `1 day`.

Aggregates numeric or boolean datapoints from the inclusive range into aligned time buckets and returns buckets in chronological order. Use this to summarize a series at a regular resolution. Numeric attributes support every formula; boolean attributes support every formula except `DIFFERENCE` and are aggregated as 1 for true and 0 for false.
interval.title: AssetDatapointIntervalQuery

amountOfPoints.description: Requested maximum number of representative datapoints after downsampling. Fewer points are returned when the range contains fewer available datapoints.

lttb.description: Downsamples numeric or boolean datapoints from the inclusive range with the Largest-Triangle-Three-Buckets (LTTB) algorithm while preserving the series' visual shape. Use this to reduce a large series for charts. Results are chronological; boolean values are processed as 1 for true and 0 for false. Null-valued observations are omitted before downsampling, so their timestamps are not returned as gap markers. A range with no available values returns no points. Other attribute value types are rejected.
lttb.title: AssetDatapointLTTBQuery

nearest.description: Returns at most one numeric datapoint: the closest value at or before the requested time. Use `fromTimestamp` as a Unix-seconds timestamp at the HTTP API boundary. `toTimestamp`, `fromTime`, and `toTime` are ignored. The equality boundary is inclusive. If the nearest datapoint has a null value, its timestamp and null value are returned.
nearest.title: AssetDatapointNearestQuery

fromTime.description: Inclusive lower range bound for `all`, `interval`, and `lttb` as an ISO local or offset date-time. A local value is interpreted in the server time zone; an offset value is converted to the server time zone. Takes precedence over `fromTimestamp` and is ignored by `nearest`.

fromTimestamp.description: Inclusive lower range bound as Unix time in milliseconds for `all`, `interval`, and `lttb`; ignored when `fromTime` is supplied. For `nearest` this is instead the requested time in Unix seconds and is the only time field used.

toTime.description: Inclusive upper range bound for `all`, `interval`, and `lttb` as an ISO local or offset date-time. A local value is interpreted in the server time zone; an offset value is converted to the server time zone. Takes precedence over `toTimestamp` and is ignored by `nearest`.

toTimestamp.description: Inclusive upper range bound as Unix time in milliseconds for `all`, `interval`, and `lttb`; ignored when `toTime` is supplied and not used by `nearest`.

schema.title: AssetDatapointQuery

body.description: Optional time range, ordering, limit, and aggregation strategy for predicted values.
